Server: short Reading Help, photo search and Story Guide. Direct provider: persistent in-reader chat, book/chapter context before the reading boundary, Markdown and saving answers to Notes. Stock BookOrbit has no chat endpoint.
The direct provider receives only confirmed reader context, questions and chat history. Photo search and Story Guide still use the server; they do not fall back.

Fallback is chosen only after a failed content-free server availability check, before sending text. The recipient is shown for confirmation. A failed submitted model request is never automatically replayed elsewhere.
